policy.causal_rule: Do not infer XRP price impact from announcements, stablecoin freezes, exchange transfers, market-cap changes or platform user ratios without synchronized, reconciled, out-of-sample evidence. Preserve asset/chain identity uncertainty and disconfirming evidence.

nodes.label: SBI Capital Co., Ltd. (historical SBIC abbreviation)

edges.claim: Binance said it was investigating a potential security issue and said user funds were safe; theft/damage was not confirmed in the cited reports.
Circle reported freezing more than $800M equivalent associated with the incident, in coordination with law enforcement; frozen is not the same as recovered.
Tether reported freezing roughly $1.5B to $1.57B associated with the incident; the event's full loss/recovery amount remains unknown.
Yi He was reported as saying Ripple froze roughly $200M. No token, chain, wallet addresses or custody mechanism were identified; do not label this XRP or RLUSD.
XRPL documentation states no one can freeze native XRP; issuers can freeze issued tokens and custodians can freeze assets held in their own custody.
Coinbase Q3 reported $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products and $307M stablecoin revenue; this is material company-wide USDC economics, not XRP-specific capital flow.
Coinbase announced RLUSD access through Prime, Exchange and retail, with deposits/withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Global Exchange collateral availability was described as future rollout.
Circle and Ripple previously announced USDC on XRPL; Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD can coexist on the same ledger, so their relationship includes cooperation as well as issuer competition.
Privy, part of Stripe, announced a Ripple/XRPL integration for programmable wallets and agentic commerce; announcement does not establish production volume or XRP demand.
Permission's ASK token supports consent/rewards and agent-to-agent coordination; official docs list LayerZero OFT on Base and Polygon, not XRPL.
GoAsk is a separate ASK-ticker asset with different supply and contract; do not merge its data with Permission Coin.

SBI's February 2025 investor presentation reported approximately 9% Ripple equity as its largest external shareholder position at that date; this is not a verified current cap table and does not identify SBIC East/West/Central as shareholders.

SBI Ripple Asia, SBI VC Trade, SBI Remit and bitbank have distinct documented XRP/XRPL/RLUSD activities. SBI Holdings' group-level activity must not be attributed to SBIC regional SME investment companies.

SBIC East, West and Central are regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies; they are not SBI Holdings or SBI Ripple Asia. No direct XRP relationship for these SBIC entities is established.
SBI Holdings used SBIC for SBI Capital Co., Ltd. in historical 2005/2007 materials; this is a separate acronym expansion from the regional SME investment/consultation companies.
SBIC East/West published ChatGPT/generative-AI training material; this is an education event, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership, SBI Holdings affiliation or XRP investment.
Coinbase page reports 98% of customers increased net XRP position over 24h; user-count share is not dollar-weighted and cannot be called actual capital inflow.
CoinMarketCap, CoinDesk and Coinbase pages report differing market-cap, volume and return values without a shared quote timestamp; do not average or admit as a synchronized feature.

Exchange deposits/withdrawals are inventory transfers, not executed purchases or fiat/stablecoin capital entering the market. Market-cap change divided by netflows is not a causal capital multiplier; CVD is an order-flow proxy, not total capital.

A Kamilah-branded YouTube channel and a podcast transcript self-introduction using Camila/Camilla are plausible same-creator candidates, but exact equivalence to requested Camilla Stephenson remains unverified; fake-page warning exists.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Large issuer freezes can improve law-enforcement containment and institutional compliance confidence while simultaneously highlighting centralized censorship/counterparty risk in fiat-backed stablecoins.
disconfirming_evidence: Binance had not confirmed theft and frozen funds are not proven recovered.
Issuer freezes may be required by law and can be viewed as a compliance feature rather than an adverse event.
No evidence yet of post-event changes in stablecoin supply, exchange balances or institutional demand.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Ripple's reported roughly $200M freeze likely concerns an issuer-controlled token, custodial asset or off-chain restriction rather than native XRP protocol freezing, but the asset remains unknown.
disconfirming_evidence: Reuters attributes the amount to Yi He's X statement but provides no token, chain or addresses.
XRPL docs explicitly say native XRP cannot be frozen at protocol level.
A custodial exchange can freeze assets it holds, independent of XRPL issuer controls.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's USDC economics remain substantial while RLUSD distribution broadens its multi-issuer stablecoin offering; this may be a distribution hedge and product expansion rather than USDC displacement.
disconfirming_evidence: No post-listing Coinbase RLUSD balances, volume, revenue share or collateral usage measured.
Q3 USDC metrics are company-wide and predate the RLUSD listing.
RLUSD and USDC may compete for the same institutional balances in some use cases.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Privy programmable-wallet integration may expand agentic commerce on XRPL, but network transaction counts and stablecoin settlement do not automatically create proportional XRP inventory demand.
disconfirming_evidence: Partnership announcement does not establish live production volume.
RLUSD and USDC can settle on XRPL without using XRP as bridge asset for every transaction.
No route-level XRP bridge, order-book, inventory or fee-demand series measured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Permission Coin ASK is a plausible candidate for the exact phrase ASK Coin because its official utility explicitly includes agent-to-agent value exchange; it is an adjacent agentic-economy project, not a verified XRPL/XRP integration.
disconfirming_evidence: GoAsk is a separate ASK ticker candidate.
Permission docs list Base and Polygon, not XRPL.
Original phrase context remains unavailable; no direct relationship with Ripple, Coinbase or Circle found.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Reported 986x/1,200x market-cap-to-exchange-netflow ratios mainly reflect marginal price repricing divided by transfer metrics, not a stable capital multiplier or the amount of cash required to move XRP.
disconfirming_evidence: Exchange netflows can still be useful for venue inventory and supply-risk analysis when reconciled with wallet labels.
Order-book depth, CVD, OTC and ETF creations/redemptions can jointly explain price impact; no complete synchronized dataset is assembled yet.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Japan's SBIC can refer to regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies or historical SBI Capital Co., Ltd. abbreviation; neither should be conflated with SBI Holdings, whose Ripple stake/partnership is separately documented.
disconfirming_evidence: The original user's phrase context may identify one specific SBIC; exact referent remains unresolved.
The 9% SBI Holdings Ripple stake is dated February 2025 and is not a current cap-table verification.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Kamilah Stevenson channel branding and Camila/Camilla transcript introductions may refer to one creator, but cannot yet be equated to the exact requested Camilla Stephenson or used as a complete channel inventory.
disconfirming_evidence: Multiple similar-name channels and fake pages are publicly noted.
The spelling difference Stephenson/Stevenson is material.
No verified channel owner statement linking the exact requested identity has been obtained.
